```{r}
seurat.merged <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/seurat.merged.rds")

list <- unique(seurat.merged$orig.ident)

#list <- list[1:3]
orig.list <- list()

for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  mat <- GetAssayData(object = seurat.merged[,seurat.merged$orig.ident == tmp], layer = "counts")
  mat <- update_gene_names_sparse(mat)
  
  so <- CreateSeuratObject(mat, min.cells = 3, min.features = 300, project = tmp)
  so$barcode <- colnames(so)
  orig.list[[tmp]] <- so 
}

saveRDS(orig.list, file = "~/hpchome/seurat.merged.list.rds")
```
